name: VelocityBots Paid API
description: VelocityBots API with MongoDB customer accounts, personal API keys, subscriptions and manual INR payment review.

COOKIE_URL.description: Public URL of the yt-dlp cookies.txt file

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection URI for customer accounts, keys, payments and usage.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random secret of at least 32 characters for signing sessions.

COOKIE_SECURE.description: Use secure cookies on HTTPS deployments.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email used for the owner account bootstrap.

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: One-time random token to enable the owner role; remove after bootstrap.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth web client ID; email/password works without it.

LEGACY_API_KEY_ENABLED.description: Keep false to enforce customer billing; true bypasses billing for the shared API_KEY.
